a record whose values cannot be changed after it is created

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the report
sections.what: Brings in the record shortcut and the path type used by the report.
sections.why: Needed to define the report record. Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: Violation
sections.title: Violation report record
sections.what: Defines one violation as a record holding the rule code, the file path, the line number and the message. Each violation is a fixed record that the command can print.
sections.why: Likely reason: a fixed record keeps each problem report consistent and safe to pass around. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Changing a field name would break every rule check and the command output together.

summary: Defines the shape of one rule violation: its code, file path, line number and message.
purpose: Gives every rule the same report format so the command can print them all the same way.
why: Likely reason: one shared report shape keeps the checks consistent. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Defines a single record type with four fields. It is frozen, so a created report cannot be changed.
inputs: Created by the rule checks with a code, path, line and message.
outputs: A report record that the command prints.
risks: Low. The record is simple and immutable.
debug: If a report prints in the wrong form, check the fields the rule check passed in.
